newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli defence chief to visit Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Israeli defence chief to visit Egypt.

text.p: Israeli Defence Minister Yitzhak Mordechai will make a one-day visit to Egypt on Tuesday to brief President Hosni Mubarak on Middle East peace moves, Israel said on Thursday.

Mordechai, hoping to ease tensions with Cairo over stalled peace talks with the Palestinians and plans to expand Jewish settlement of occupied Arab lands, will meet Mubarak in the Red Sea resort city of Hurghada, a defence ministry statement said.
Egypt, which in 1979 became the first Arab state to make peace with Israel, has questioned the commitment to peace of right-wing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who took office six months ago.
